title: Operator Telemetry Convergence & Skill Roadmap (2026)
author: Lena Martinez
body:
Overview

This roadmap captures a 4-quarter program to converge platform telemetry, reduce noise and cost, standardize operator tooling, and run a phased skill uplift for platform operators. The program is scoped to the Platform Telemetry domain (ingestion, enrichment, dashboards, alerting, synthetic validation) and the Operator Surface (console, runbooks, preflight checks).

Goals

- Consolidate overlapping telemetry pipelines into a single Platform Telemetry Hub (PTH) to improve signal quality and lower ingestion costs by 25% by Q1 2027.
- Reduce actionable alert volume by 40% through smarter alert synthesis and SLI reweighting.
- Shorten mean time to acknowledge (MTTA) for degradation incidents to < 5 minutes for P1s and < 15 minutes for P2s.
- Certify 80% of operators on the new Operator Skill Path (OSP) by end of program.

Scope and Non-Goals

In scope:
- Telemetry convergence for LLM serving stacks (batching, kv-cache, scheduler) and platform control plane.
- Dashboard and alert library standardization and ownership handoff.
- Operator training curriculum and certification.

Out of scope:
- Upstream model infra changes (model code or kernels).
- Billing/finance rework beyond token cost dashboards.

Principles

1. One source of truth: pipelines should feed PTH; downstream consumers should not maintain independent ingestion.
2. Signal over noise: prefer composite signals (SLOs, token burn rate, cold-start rate) to single noisy metrics.
3. Operator-first UX: dashboards and runbooks prioritized for oncall efficiency.
4. Iterative rollout with synthetic validation and game-day verification.

High-level Timeline (by quarter)

- Q2 2026 (Discovery & Pilot):
  - Audit existing telemetry owners and catalogs. Deliver telemetry dependency map.
  - Build PTH prototype with ingestion adapters for: serve-metrics, prefixcache-proxy, batching-router, tenant-credit-service.
  - Run two operator game-days using prototype dashboards.

- Q3 2026 (Consolidation & Alert Baseline):
  - Migrate 50% of consumers to PTH.
  - Establish baseline alert volume and false positive rate per SLO.
  - Launch Alert Synthesis Engine (ASE) v0: groups related signals and suppresses duplicates.
  - Publish initial Operator Skill Path (OSP) curriculum: Fundamentals, Telemetry Forensics, Escalation Decision Canvas.

- Q4 2026 (Optimization & Training):
  - Complete migration of core serving signals into PTH.
  - Implement cost-signal gating: tiered retention for low-value metrics. Target 18% ingestion reduction this quarter.
  - ASE v1 adds cost-aware ranking and context enrichment hooks for runbooks.
  - Run live cert exams for OSP Level 1.

- Q1 2027 (Stabilize & Handback):
  - SLA bake-in and SLO contract signoffs with customer-success and product.
  - Finalize dashboard library and documented handback to service owners.
  - 80% operator certification target met; program enters steady-state training cadence.

Deliverables and Success Metrics

- Platform Telemetry Hub (PTH) deployed in prod (service name: platform-telemetry-hub).
- Dashboard library: 12 canonical dashboards (Latency, Token Cost, Cache Health, Prefetch Cohorts, Batch Efficiency, Tenant Credit Exposure, SLO Burn Overview).
- Alert Synthesis Engine (ASE) with configurable grouping and suppression rules.
- Operator Skill Path (OSP) with 3 certification levels and exam artifacts.
- Success metrics: ingestion cost down 25%, actionable alerts down 40%, MTTA < 5m for P1s, operator survey NPS >= +35 after training.

Instrumentation Specification (required metrics)

Operators and service owners must ensure the following metrics are emitted with these labels:

- serve_request_latency_ms{service, model_variant, region, tenant} (histogram)
- token_consumption{tenant, request_type} (counter)
- kv_cache_hit_ratio{shard, model_variant} (gauge)
- batch_efficiency{pool_id, seq_len_bucket} (gauge)
- cold_start_rate{instance_type} (counter)
- operator_action_latency{operator_id, action} (timer)

For each metric include resource tags: cluster, AZ, build_sha, deploy_env.

Dashboard & Alerting Standards

- Dashboards must:
  1) Use SLO-centric top-level panel.
  2) Surface correlated cost and latency panels side-by-side.
  3) Include pre-filtered time ranges: 15m, 1h, 24h, 7d.

- Alert thresholds guidance (examples):
  - P1: serving_p99_latency > 1200ms for 3m AND token_consumption rate spike > 3x baseline => pager duty P1.
  - P2: kv_cache_hit_ratio < 0.6 for 10m => notify oncall with playbook link.
  - Cost alert: token_consumption for a tenant > 5x rolling 7d median and not explained by release tag => create ticket and notify billing-signal channel.

Sample ASE rule (YAML)

code:
  - name: p99-latency-spike-composite
    group_by: [service, region]
    conditions:
      - metric: serve_request_latency_ms_p99
        comparator: '>'
        threshold: 1200
        duration: 180s
      - metric: token_consumption_rate
        comparator: '>'
        threshold: '3 * baseline'
    actions:
      - notify: pd-oncall
      - attach-dashboard: dashboard-id:latency-slo
      - run-suppression: if correlated_cache_drop within 5m

Operator Skill Path (OSP) outline

- Level 0 (Observer): 1 hour course, dashboard walkthrough, intro runbook.
- Level 1 (Responder): 1 day lab, two simulated incidents, written exam.
- Level 2 (Diagnostician): 3 day deep-dive, ownership of a telemetry domain, live proctored incident.

Training and Certification Plan

1. Q3 2026: Publish self-paced modules and host weekly office hours.
2. Q4 2026: Instructor-led labs and first cert run.
3. Q1 2027: Mentorship pairs; require shadowing two P1 incidents for Level 2.
4. Ongoing: Quarterly recertification via 2-hour practical exam.

Rollout & Migration Playbook (high level)

1. Telemetry Audit: maintain a CSV of producers, consumers, and cardinality. (Owner: telemetry-platform)
2. Pilot consumer migration: pick two low-risk consumers (prefetch-lab, shadow-latency) and migrate to PTH.
3. Validation: run synthetic scenarios (cold-cache storm, token-burst) and compare alerts.
4. Bulk migration in waves with operator training scheduled between waves.
5. Handback: update service-level dashboard links and archive old pipelines.

Ownership & RACI (text table)

- Program Lead: Lena Martinez (engineering)
- Telemetry Platform: telemetry-platform (team)
- Operator Training: platform-ops-learning (team)
- Cost & Billing Signals: finance-ops (team)
- ASE Delivery: runtime-observability (team)

Risks and Mitigations

- Risk: Loss of legacy signals during migration. Mitigation: Dual-write for 4 weeks and automated reconciliation checks.
- Risk: Operators overwhelmed by retraining. Mitigation: Staggered cohorts and recorded sessions.
- Risk: Cost savings not realized. Mitigation: Quarterly cost reviews and retention tuning.

Game-Day and Validation Recipes

- Cold-Cache Storm: simulate 10x prefix cache miss rate for 30m, verify ASE groups related alerts and does not pageduty for known degradation pattern.
- Token Surge: synthetic tenant emits 10x token rate for 15m; verify cost alert, token attribution traces, and runbook activation.

Post-Implementation Reviews

- Schedule structured retrospectives after each migration wave. Use the following template:
  1) What happened (facts)
  2) What went well
  3) Where we were surprised
  4) Action items with owners and due dates
